row.team_price_text: Team: $39/mo per Team Room (monthly or annual)
row.evidence: Retrium's pricing grid lists "User Management SCIM API" only under Enterprise (Contact Sales), and its help centre says "Enterprise Edition organizations can request access to the Retrium API", which is based on SCIM 2.0.
row.notes: Changed since June: the pricing grid now marks User Management SCIM API as Enterprise-only (Business gets SAML SSO but not SCIM), and the help centre requires an active Enterprise Edition subscription for the SCIM-based Retrium API and Okta provisioning (c4, c7, c13, c20). Status stays gated but scim_plan moves from Business to Enterprise (Contact Sales). Business is now shown as $715 per Team Room per year billed annually on the desktop grid; the mobile card still says $59 per Team Room per month (conflict). Pricing is flat per Team Room with unlimited users, so per-user fields are null; June's $59/$39 multiplier is dropped because SCIM is no longer on Business. User-based plans are Enterprise-only. The API must be enabled by Retrium and its reference documentation is only provided after enablement.

plans.name: Team
plans.price_text: $39 per Team Room/month, billed monthly or annually
plans.notes: Flat per Team Room, unlimited users.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Mobile pricing card still says $59 per Team Room per month.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: User-based plans available on Enterprise only.

operations.notes: Only create, update (first and last name) and deactivate are documented; Okta's catalogue page does not check Group Push or Group Linking. Update method (PUT vs PATCH) is not documented.

deprovision.notes: Billing is per Team Room, not per user, so seats are not the billing unit on Team/Business.

attributes.notes: Only first and last name updates are documented publicly; full attribute list is provided only after the API is enabled.

roles.how: New SCIM users are set to Org Member; roles are changed in the Members tab.

limitations.text: Users created via SCIM are not automatically added to Team Rooms and get the Org Member role.
The API must be enabled for the organization by Retrium (Account Manager or success@retrium.com); reference documentation is provided only after enablement.
The Okta app must be re-added if it was added before October 1, 2022.

audit_log_api.notes: Only an in-app Team Room Activity Log is documented (c24).

user_api.notes: The only documented API is the SCIM 2.0-based Retrium API (recorded under scim). No separate non-SCIM user-management API is documented publicly.

okta.notes: OIN page markup checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate; Group Push, Group Linking and Sync Password are not checked. SCIM only for Enterprise Edition.

entra.notes: Retrium's own Entra guide uses a non-gallery custom SAML app; no Entra gallery tutorial found (learn.microsoft.com retrium-tutorial returned 404).

fallbacks.notes: SAML SSO with optional JIT on Business and Enterprise. Bulk invite of up to 20 comma-separated emails, No CSV import documented.

open_questions: SCIM base URL, auth method, token expiry, endpoints, filtering and attribute list are only shared after the API is enabled.
Whether SCIM deactivation frees anything billable (billing is per Team Room) or ends sessions is not documented.
Whether Retrium has an Entra, Google, OneLogin or JumpCloud catalogue app is not confirmed.
No audit-log API or non-SCIM user API is documented.
